prompt: Watch this funny clip: my tiny dog runs (fast) that big brown hound!
explanation_ru: Для сравнения равной скорости действий используется конструкция as + наречие + as: as fast as.

prompt: With six broken lamps, the seafront path isn't (bright) the main street.
explanation_ru: В отрицательном предложении неравное сравнение строится по схеме not as/so + прилагательное + as.

prompt: Please note: thin wire locks are not (safe) heavy steel chains.
explanation_ru: Для выражения неравенства качеств после not используется конструкция as/so safe as.

prompt: Our brand-new kitchen fan is (twice / loud) my old vacuum cleaner.
explanation_ru: Со словом twice используется конструкция as + прилагательное + as: twice as loud as.

prompt: The hotel breakfast bar doesn't offer (much / warm bread) guests expect.
explanation_ru: С неисчисляемым существительным warm bread требуется конструкция as much + существительное + as.

prompt: Gothenburg's new electric ferry moves across the water (quietly) a wooden boat.
explanation_ru: Глагол moves описывается наречием, поэтому для равного сравнения нужно as quietly as.

prompt: Kiran says this blue cotton bag is very ___ the green one.
explanation_ru: Прилагательное similar всегда требует предлога to. Предлоги with, as и like здесь ошибочны.

prompt: Kwame laughed because Kofi's new striped tie was ___ his own tie.
explanation_ru: Полное совпадение передаётся через the same as; замена as на like или than — частая ошибка.

prompt: Aljaz saw both chemists sell cold packs at the same price like each other.
answer: Aljaz saw both chemists sell cold packs at the same price as each other.
accepted_answers: Aljaz saw both chemists sell cold packs at the same price as each other.
Aljaz saw that both chemists sell cold packs at the same price as each other.
explanation_ru: После выражения the same всегда используется союз as, а не like.

prompt: Aiden's blue lunchbox is just like Tyler's lunchbox. → Aiden's blue lunchbox is the same …
answer: Aiden's blue lunchbox is the same as Tyler's lunchbox.
accepted_answers: Aiden's blue lunchbox is the same as Tyler's lunchbox.
Aiden's blue lunchbox is the same as Tyler's.
explanation_ru: Фраза just like заменяется конструкцией the same as с сохранением смысла.

prompt: Did both job applicants tidy the greenhouse bench (carefully) each other during their morning trial in Odense?
explanation_ru: В вопросе о том, одинаково ли аккуратно выполнено действие, используется as carefully as.

prompt: With giant adverts filling my phone, this news app doesn't leave (much / space) a normal website.
explanation_ru: С неисчисляемым существительным space в отрицании используется конструкция as/so much space as.

prompt: Stavros told me the familiar red tin doesn't hold (many / biscuits) it did a few months ago.
explanation_ru: С исчисляемым существительным во множественном числе biscuits используется as/so many biscuits as.

prompt: Why do the noisy kitchen trays next door clatter (loudly) the musicians during gentle folk songs?
explanation_ru: Для сравнения громкости звучания двух действий с глаголом clatter требуется наречие в форме as loudly as.

prompt: Hold onto your hot chips by the harbour, because bold gulls swoop down (quickly) you can blink.
explanation_ru: Конструкция as + наречие + as сравнивает скорость двух действий: as quickly as you can blink.

prompt: I stopped at a harbourside cafe in Whitby hoping for a warm afternoon treat. Sadly, my hot chocolate wasn't (rich) I expected, and the burnt teacake tasted completely (different) a fresh one. Even worse, their tiny drinks were (twice / expensive) the friendly bakery's menu.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске нужно отрицательное сравнение as/so rich as, во втором — different from (или to), а в третьем — кратное сравнение twice as expensive as.

prompt: Didier: "Corinne, did your apple pie really bake (well) mine?" Corinne: "We picked completely separate recipes online this morning. Yet my crust turned out just (crisp) yours, and both tarts even have (the same / colour) each other."
explanation_ru: С глаголом bake используется наречие as well as, с прилагательным — as crisp as, а одинаковый цвет передаётся конструкцией the same colour as.

prompt: Jeroen and Ilse checked out two small guesthouses along a brick canal in Delft. Both places charge (the same / fee) each other for bike hire and serve tea in blue-and-white cups. The attic room isn't (large) the garden suite, yet its morning view is remarkably (similar) a classic Dutch painting.
explanation_ru: Для одинаковой платы нужно the same fee as, в отрицании — as/so large as, а после прилагательного similar всегда ставится предлог to.

prompt: Jody smiled after testing an old scratched guitar at a Saturday market in Asheville. "Listen to that—this dusty instrument rings out (clearly) a shiny new model in town," he told me. "Its wooden neck isn't (smooth) a factory-made one, yet the shop version is (three times / pricey) this bargain."
explanation_ru: После глагола rings out требуется наречие as clearly as, в отрицании — as/so smooth as, а трёхкратная разница выражается через three times as pricey as.

prompt: Gunter chuckled at the police desk because the second blue bike helmet looked ___ the first one, including a yellow flower sticker.
explanation_ru: Единственно правильная форма — almost the same as. Сочетания the same like, so similar as и as ... than неверны.

prompt: Hassan showed our tour group that hand-woven bread baskets in Aswan aren't very ___ the antique baskets displayed upstairs.
explanation_ru: После прилагательного different используется предлог from, а не like, with или as.

prompt: Jillian wrote in her cinema review that the new space film wasn't as clever than last summer's hit.
answer: Jillian wrote in her cinema review that the new space film wasn't as clever as last summer's hit.
accepted_answers: Jillian wrote in her cinema review that the new space film wasn't as clever as last summer's hit.
Jillian wrote in her cinema review that the new space film wasn't so clever as last summer's hit.
explanation_ru: В паре с as (или so) всегда используется второй союз as, а не than.

prompt: Kasia and Marek bought office laptops from two different brands in Krakow. When they checked the details, both machines weighed 1.3 kg and lasted ten hours on one charge.
options: Kasia's laptop is twice as heavy as Marek's machine.
Marek's laptop doesn't last nearly as long as Kasia's.
Both laptops have the same weight and battery life despite their different brands.
The two laptops look completely different from each other on paper.
explanation_ru: Характеристики обоих ноутбуков полностью совпадают, поэтому верен вариант с the same weight and battery life.

prompt: Throughout the lively table-tennis tournament in Busan, Minseo returned each spinning serve (hard) Jihoon could hit it, pushing all five games into tiebreaks.
explanation_ru: Наречие hard в конструкции as hard as показывает, что ответный удар был таким же сильным, как подача соперника.

prompt: Although my twin sister Petra and I wrote our essays in separate cafes in Brno, our tutor gave me almost (many / comments) her, down to the same phrasing.
explanation_ru: Для сравнения количества исчисляемого существительного comments используется конструкция as many comments as.

prompt: Gerald rarely misses a show at Chichester's festival theatre, yet he left Friday's performance frustrated. During the quiet moonlit garden scene, the glowing green exit signs shone (brightly) the stage spotlights themselves. Because the auditorium isn't (dark) it ought to be, the atmosphere felt totally (different) the magic he expected.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске глагол shone требует наречия as brightly as, во втором нужно отрицательное сравнение as/so dark as, а в третьем — different from (или to).

prompt: Mei and Fatima stood laughing beside the baggage belt at Changi Airport after nearly swapping cases. Not only did Mei's teal suitcase look (similar) Fatima's bag, but both even had a yellow ribbon tied to the handle. Mei's bag was actually (half / heavy) Fatima's, so she realised the mistake (soon) she lifted it off the belt.
explanation_ru: После similar ставится предлог to, кратное уменьшение веса передаётся через half as heavy as, а мгновенное действие — союзом as soon as.

prompt: Along a lantern-lit soup lane in Hue, regular diners love teasing two rival noodle cooks across the street. Neither cook will admit it, yet the spicy broth on the north side tastes (good) the recipe across the road. Both kitchens slice fresh herbs (fast) humanly possible, and the tiny stall stays (busy) its larger rival until closing time.
explanation_ru: После глаголов состояния tastes и stays ставятся прилагательные (as good as, as busy as), а после глагола действия slice — наречие as fast as.

prompt: Inside the optics lab in Jena, Uwe explained to our class that the twin mirrors are polished to ___ while tracking clouds on opposite sides of Earth.
options: exact same curve like each other
the same curve as each other
as curved shape as each other
the same curve than each other
explanation_ru: Слово same требует определённого артикля the и союза as: the same curve as each other.

prompt: Esteban emailed the town officials because early delivery vans make four times as much noise than the quiet electric buses allowed near the stone arches.
answer: Esteban emailed the town officials because early delivery vans make four times as much noise as the quiet electric buses allowed near the stone arches.
accepted_answers: Esteban emailed the town officials because early delivery vans make four times as much noise as the quiet electric buses allowed near the stone arches.
explanation_ru: В конструкции four times as much noise as нельзя заменять второй союз as на than.

prompt: Ronan stopped painting to admire how the twin lakes in Killarney mirrored the orange autumn hills with the exact same glassy brightness as each other.
answer: Ronan stopped painting to admire how the twin lakes in Killarney mirrored the orange autumn hills with the exact same glassy brightness as each other.
accepted_answers: Ronan stopped painting to admire how the twin lakes in Killarney mirrored the orange autumn hills with the exact same glassy brightness as each other.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: конструкция the exact same + существительное + as each other построена полностью правильно.

prompt: At Tauranga's Saturday farmers market, the jam judges announced a tie because two neighbours' plum jams were equally glossy and tangy, despite coming from completely different recipes.
options: One neighbour's plum jam tasted far sweeter than the other jar.
The two neighbours used the exact same recipe, so the judges refused to pick a winner.
Neither jar looked as glossy as the winning jam from last year.
The second neighbour's plum jam turned out just as glossy and tangy as the first one's.
explanation_ru: Оба варенья оказались одинаково блестящими и терпкими, что точно передаёт вариант с just as glossy and tangy as.

prompt: Dev and Ananya saw that the jar of warm tap water didn't look any different from the chilled water until a drop of dye revealed the movement. → Dev and Ananya saw that the jar of warm tap water looked the same …
answer: Dev and Ananya saw that the jar of warm tap water looked the same as the chilled water until a drop of dye revealed the movement.
accepted_answers: Dev and Ananya saw that the jar of warm tap water looked the same as the chilled water until a drop of dye revealed the movement.
explanation_ru: Отрицание разницы (didn't look any different from) равнозначно утвердительной конструкции looked the same as.
